deliverables_lineage.name: deliverables_lineage
deliverables_lineage.value: ("deliverables"."parent_deliverable_id" is null and "deliverables"."version"=1) or ("deliverables"."parent_deliverable_id" is not null and "deliverables"."parent_deliverable_id"<>"deliverables"."id" and "deliverables"."version">1)

message_proposal_shape.name: message_proposal_shape
message_proposal_shape.value: ("messages"."type" = 'message' and "messages"."chain_id" is null and "messages"."reply_to" is null and "messages"."proposal_data" is null) or ("messages"."client_id" is not null and "messages"."chain_id" is not null and (("messages"."type" = 'proposal' and "messages"."chain_id" = "messages"."id" and "messages"."reply_to" is null and "messages"."proposal_data" is not null) or ("messages"."type" = 'counter' and "messages"."reply_to" is not null and "messages"."proposal_data" is not null) or ("messages"."type" in ('accept','reject') and "messages"."reply_to" is not null and "messages"."proposal_data" is null)))

projects_dates.name: projects_dates
projects_dates.value: "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."due_date" is null or "projects"."due_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

settings_appearance.name: settings_appearance
settings_appearance.value: "settings"."typography" in ('editorial','modern') and "settings"."density" in ('comfortable','compact') and "settings"."corners" in ('soft','square') and "settings"."light_palette" in ('warm','cool') and "settings"."dark_palette" in ('slate','midnight')
